items.text: PHP2Shell, day two: millions of exploit attempts, a Mirai botnet variant trying to ride on it, and still zero confirmed breaches. The UK alone has 32 government digital services switched off.
Researchers who watched the first 48 hours say reliable exploitation is harder than the leak implied, while Censys still counts 34.4 million vulnerable PHP services.
CISA has not added the two PHP flaws to its exploited-vulnerabilities list and has issued no emergency directive; a listing would be its verdict that exploitation is real.
